profile_text.body:
Scite is a for-profit startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in Brooklyn, NY, that describes itself as an AI-powered platform for discovering and evaluating scientific literature. The company says it has indexed more than 1.6 billion citations, searches across more than 300 million scholarly articles, and serves 2 million users worldwide. It is now part of Research Solutions, and the site states it is built on a licensed database assembled through agreements with more than 40 publishers plus the full open access corpus.

The platform's core feature is Smart Citations, which categorize how later research has supported, challenged, or discussed a given paper, claim, method, journal, author, institution, or funder. An AI Assistant uses those same citation signals to generate answers grounded in the broader literature, with every claim linked back to the specific sentence in the specific source paper. The company describes this as the difference between an answer that can be cited and one that requires re-verification.

The held facts record one AI product under the Search, Research, Translation and Other category, listed simply as Scite, covering smart citation analysis, claim verification, research quality, and academic trust. Scite also maintains a registered MCP server, ai.scite/mcp, described as a tool to ground answers in scientific literature through full-text search, trust evaluation, and full-text article access. No litigation or SEC filings are noted in the held facts.
